criteria.region: France's Atlantic southwest — coastal Gironde (Médoc + Cap-Ferret peninsula) plus the Born plateau in northern Landes (Biscarrosse / Sanguinet / Parentis lakes + Biscarrosse-Plage surf). All within ~20 min of ocean surf or kite-friendly water; all within ~1-1.5 hr of Bordeaux-Mérignac airport.
criteria.notes: Hard filters: 23 communes across coastal Gironde and northern Landes + €400k-1.3M. Everything else is scored 0-100 by Claude Haiku.
